reason: The full article copy shows a broad 2020 survey of general DNN compression and hardware acceleration, with the main categories compact models, tensor decomposition, quantization, and sparsification. It briefly mentions NAS for transformer architectures, but the surveyed methods and performance tables are not LLM/generative-transformer inference evaluations. The methods may transfer to LLM compression, yet direct coverage is not established; retain as borderline rather than accept or unrelated.
title: Model Compression and Hardware Acceleration for Neural Networks: A Comprehensive Survey
